newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends barely changed.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished barely changed on Monday, reflecting relatively balanced demand and supply for the U.S. dollar, dealers said.
The local unit closed at T$27.812 against Saturday's T$27.814 close.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$298.5 million.

The Taiwan dollar had risen in recent sessions due to soaring short-term interest rates in the banking system, but short-covering on the U.S. dollar and commercial greenback demand offset the local unit's rise, dealers said.
The rate fluctuated within a very narrow T$27.800-825 range throughout the day.
Dealers said Hong Kong's midnight return to Chinese rule had little impact on the market.
"The market is indifferent towards the Hong Kong handover," the dealer said.
A range of T$27.80-85 was seen for Wednesday. Taiwan's financial markets are closed on Tuesday for banks' semiannual settlement of accounts.
